column1: # CUS model — the RELATION layer (structured: claims as subject-predicate-object).
# columns: id <TAB> kind <TAB> subject <TAB> predicate <TAB> object <TAB> ruling <TAB> pattern <TAB> statement
#   kind = canonical (an asserted true relation; pattern empty)
#        | forbidden  (a retired claim; pattern = Python regex that detects it in prose)
# This is the 'machine language' for how terms relate. Forbidden rows drive the prose sweep;
# canonical rows say what IS true. Every row cites a ruling. Checked by check.py.

column8: You author the Figure Definition; the authored fields are authoritative.
The Archetype is rendered from the Figure; never authored/stored/resolved.
FrameSpec = Role x Tool, a socket schema that owns no fact.
Signature specializes the functional frame — the Role x Tool / FrameSpec cell — into a decision loop; not the physical Frame.
Tempo is the cadence of the decision loop, not movement.
The Figure Definition cell owns role/tool; FrameSpec owns nothing.
The Caravan carries Books; membership is a Relationship, not a stored roster.
Book->Figure is a membership Relationship — an edge to the individual Figure Instance, not a stored roster. Neither Book nor Caravan owns a roster list.
Scar is Figure Instance State (Wounds->Injury->Scar; Mind Scar), not an Overlay.
Nerve is a tiered save rolled per incoming Morale point.
AP is by Rank — Square 2, Circle 3.
Packet Tools are Melee/Ranged/Hybrid (no Reaction/Support category).
Every Object stands on three orthogonal axes.
Both Packet-card faces are Presentation; the JSON in code is the Definition.
Charge accumulates potential, then releases it as one committed burst (ACCUMULATE->HOLD->RELEASE->RESET).
Channel continuously applies an effect while the source stays committed (BEGIN->MAINTAIN->END).
Cycle alternates productive use with forced restoration around a Reserve (READY->SPEND->EMPTY->RESTORE).
Reserve is the finite Resource kind (spend->empty->restore); renamed from the old 'Charge' Resource.
Archetype is a rendered Presentation view — never operative/authored/stored.
You author the Figure; Presentation renders the Archetype (never authored/stored/resolved).
Frame does not contain Archetypes; FrameSpec is a socket schema.
Frame is a FrameSpec (schema) + physical Frame — not a layer or root Object.
FrameSpec owns no fact; the Figure Definition owns role/tool.
The 3-dice Nerve test is retired; Nerve is a tiered save.
Reaction-as-Resource is struck; out-of-turn = free Written Triggers, capped by Position.
No Reaction/Support Packet category; Tools are Melee/Ranged/Hybrid.
AP is by Rank — Square 2, Circle 3; 'AP=3 for all' is struck drift.
